summary: Tested (A) AI Assistant hidden/denied for staff/volunteer and (B) event-branded Staff/Volunteer emails (preview API + AvailabilityDialog preview UI + invite existing/new paths). Backend 15/15 pytest pass. Frontend: volunteer & staff in /app (VolunteerLayout) have no header-assistant-button, no support-fab, and dispatching 'support-chat:open' opens nothing, at 1920 and 390px. Org admin sees header-assistant-button and the chat panel opens (no question sent). Events -> Disponibilità -> availability-dialog shows staff-email-preview with 4 buttons; each shows correct email-preview-meta (Da: 'Maratona di Pisa | CRMEvent', correct subjects) and iframe with MP initials header, event name, 14/03/2027, greeting, body, CTA (nuovo->/attiva?token=ANTEPRIMA, esistente->/login, disponibilita no CTA) and CRMEvent footer. One visual bug: the footer CRMEvent logo uses the white-text variant so 'CRM' is invisible on the white footer.

minor.issue: The footer loads /logo-crmevent-dark.png, which has white 'CRM' text for dark backgrounds. On the white email footer only the icon and 'Event' show. It is also a 359KB PNG shown at 72px. Use logo-crmevent.png (dark text) or a small optimised light-background variant.

The sender is built as f"{from_name} <addr>" with no RFC5322 quoting. An event name with a comma, quotes, '<' or ';' (e.g. 'Maratona, Pisa') can produce an invalid From header, and the provider may reject the send. Quote and escape the display name, or strip special characters.

ui_bugs.issue: The CRMEvent footer logo shows only 'Event' because the white 'CRM' text is invisible on white (backend asset choice).

issues: data-testid availability-{id} appears twice (one hidden, for responsive layout). Tests must use :visible. Consider unique testids.
Event date shows the raw ISO '2027-03-14' instead of dd/mm/yyyy (existing issue, minor).

action_items: Change FOOTER_LOGO_URL in email_utils.py to a logo with dark text on a light background (e.g. logo-crmevent.png or an optimised small PNG)
Quote and escape from_name in the Resend sender string (and check the Brevo/managed senders) so event names with commas or special characters can't break the From header
critical_code_review_comments: _do_person_invite 'activated' branch: if the email belongs to an already-active staff/volunteer user of ANOTHER org, an admin invite overwrites that user's org_id and role. The user silently moves tenants (cross-tenant takeover; admins skip the 409 membership check in _send_person_invite). The 'elif existing' branch can also downgrade an existing admin/superadmin user to staff/volunteer and reset their activation token. Consider rejecting or warning when the existing user has a different org_id or a non staff/volunteer role. This path seems to predate this change, but the new existing-account flow makes it easier to hit.
staff_email_preview uses the admin's own name ('Ciao Test,'). That's fine, but a neutral placeholder like 'Mario' would make the preview clearer.

_staff_mail_event falls back to the most recent event when evento_id isn't linked to the person. Good. Without any link it falls back to 'CRMEvent' as the event name, giving the subject 'CRMEvent – Attiva...' and the from name 'CRMEvent | CRMEvent'. Use a nicer fallback, e.g. the org name.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; footer logo visual bug)
